releaseNotes: Colour theme choice (dark, light, or follow your phone), show or hide the Skills tab, Progress tab, readiness check-in and Milestones, and a search box in Settings. If you are on 4.2: install over your current app, it uses the same signing key, so your data is kept; do not uninstall first. If you are on 4.1 or older: read the release notes first.
